arc.fallback: Tarkus and the Dark Knight Bruford

description.fallback: Jonathan is fighting the black knights when a zombie ambushes him from behind. Bruford gets behind the zombie and rips off its nose and the skin around it, before asking Dio to allow him to defeat Jonathan himself. Dio notices that Bruford is acting on his knightly pride rather than his master's orders, but allows Bruford to do as he wishes.
